privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.content:
Privacy Policy

Version 1.0

Who we are

Cozy Health Limited (registration number 8215009), Igwe Street, Rumuodara, Rivers State, Nigeria, operates Cozy Health and determines the operation of its consumer-controlled wellbeing service. This policy covers the app, website and optional individual provider connections. Contact us for privacy questions, access, correction, export, deletion or complaints.

Email Team@cozyhealth.org. Requests enter a shared team queue and are assigned to an available team member. Responses are generally faster between 8am and 5pm West Africa Time (WAT, UTC+1). These are not guaranteed operating hours or a response-time promise; the inbox is not continuously monitored.

Information we process

We process account details and credentials; mood and wellbeing entries; journals and associated recordings where used; assessment responses and scores; provider connections, sharing choices and messages; community contributions; and security and access records. Student applicants may submit institution and enrolment evidence. Emergency-contact setup collects the contact details needed for the chosen contact method.

Some information is stored in an account-specific local cache for offline use and synchronized with our service. Removing the app is not the same as deleting your account.

Why we process information

We use information to provide requested features, maintain accounts, score assessments, enable chosen provider sharing, protect the service and respond to support requests. We rely on contract where applicable for necessary account/service administration, legitimate interests for proportionate security, fraud prevention and support, and legal obligations where processing is required by law. You may object to legitimate-interest processing under applicable law.

Consent-based processing of health and wellbeing information requires a separate explicit choice. Optional analytics, diagnostics and marketing have independent choices. Accepting the Terms or reading this policy does not supply health-data consent. Consent can be withdrawn without changing the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Assessment scoring supports self-reflection and tracking; it does not make a diagnosis, determine insurance/employment eligibility or replace professional judgment. We do not sell personal information, share it for cross-context behavioural advertising, or use private health content for targeted advertising.

Provider sharing is your choice

A linked provider can see your first name, identifier, sharing choices and assigned-resource status. Optional categories start off: mood entries; journal summaries; assessment results; and provider notes. Journal summaries may include titles, type, word count and dates, but do not include journal bodies, transcripts or recordings. Specific assessment-result sharing requires the applicable result permission.

Providers may view or export authorized information. You can turn categories off or disconnect in My Provider. New requests respect changes; already viewed, copied or downloaded information cannot be recalled. Reconnecting starts with optional categories off.

Optional analytics and diagnostics

PostHog is the selected usage-analytics provider but is not configured for this launch. Once configured and only after opt-in, selected events may measure participating users’ app activity, signup/onboarding progress, general feature use, return visits, app version and platform. Analytics excludes journal text, chat messages, mood values, assessment responses/results, crisis activity, emergency contacts and student evidence. Session recording and automatic interaction capture stay off. Analytics can be disabled in Privacy settings.

Sentry diagnostic code is integrated in the app, but transmission requires a configured release and a separate crash-reporting opt-in. Filtering is designed to exclude private content and credentials. Firebase Cloud Messaging is reserved for push notifications, which remain inactive until configured; it is not our usage-analytics provider.

Vendors and transfers

Railway hosts the application, databases and private files. The current application/database and storage deployments are in the western United States. Brevo provides transactional email. Formspree processes website waitlist submissions. Cloudflare provides domain DNS; it is not currently the reverse proxy for application/API traffic. Development and source-code tools do not need your private journal or assessment content.

Apple or Google receive sign-in information if you choose their sign-in options. Purchase processing begins only when store billing is activated. PostHog and Sentry serve the separate optional purposes described above when configured and enabled.

Information may be processed outside Nigeria and your home country. Where transfer restrictions apply, the relevant transfer must have a lawful mechanism and necessary safeguards, such as approved contractual clauses where applicable. Contact Team@cozyhealth.org for details of the safeguards applicable to your information. This notice does not itself establish a missing vendor agreement or permit a restricted transfer.

Retention and deletion

We retain active account and wellbeing information while the account is active, unless you delete an item earlier or a shorter feature-specific period applies. Confirmed account deletion removes the active account and related records covered by the deletion process. Remaining account files and recoverable backup copies must be removed or expire within 30 days, except for a documented legal obligation or hold. Restricted backups are for recovery and must not reintroduce deleted accounts into ordinary service.

Routine security and access records have a two-year limit. Raw student-verification evidence is removed within 30 days of collection; the eligibility decision and expiry may remain while needed to administer the account. Inactive waitlist entries are removed after 12 months without renewed interest. We retain only the minimum records needed for a documented legal obligation, dispute or incident and review each exception when it ends.

Provider-held copies are controlled by the provider and cannot be recalled by deleting your Cozy Health account. Unlinking a provider is not account deletion. Visit cozyhealth.org/support to request deletion without the app. Store subscriptions, when available, must be cancelled through the store separately.

Young people

Cozy Health is intended for ages 13 and older; under-13 accounts are not permitted. Users aged 13–17 need the applicable verified guardian authorization before health-data features are enabled. Additional local age and consent restrictions may apply. Worldwide interest does not mean every feature is available in every country.

A guardian confirms contact details and authority, and staff review authorization before activation. Entering an email or ticking a box is not completed verification. Guardian approval does not automatically expose private journals, messages or provider records. Read cozyhealth.org/guardians for the Young People and Guardian Notice.

Your choices and complaints

You can change optional analytics, diagnostics, marketing and provider-sharing choices independently. Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, portability, deletion or restriction; object to certain processing; and withdraw consent. Contact Team@cozyhealth.org. We use proportionate identity/authority checks; do not send passwords, full journals or government ID with an initial request.

We handle requests within applicable legal deadlines and explain any lawful exception or permitted extension. Support availability does not extend statutory deadlines. You may complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission at ndpc.gov.ng, or the competent authority where you live. Local consumer and privacy protections remain available.

Withdrawal of health-data consent stops future consent-based processing and may make related features unavailable. It does not undo earlier lawful processing or retrieve provider-held copies. Emergency resources remain accessible.

Changes to this policy

Each published policy has an identified version and permanent link. We communicate material changes as required and obtain a fresh choice where necessary for new consent-based purposes. Contact the company at the postal address above or Team@cozyhealth.org.

tos.content:
Terms of Use

Version 1.0

Operator and eligibility

Cozy Health Limited (registration number 8215009), Igwe Street, Rumuodara, Rivers State, Nigeria, provides Cozy Health. These Terms govern your personal account and website use. Use accurate account information and protect your credentials. Accounts are for ages 13 and older. Users aged 13–17 require the applicable verified guardian authorization before health-data features are enabled. Additional local restrictions may apply; do not bypass eligibility checks.

For launch, individuals control their own accounts and choose whether to share selected information with an individual provider. These Terms do not create an organization-managed clinic service or authorize regulated processing on behalf of a healthcare organization. Health-data consent and optional choices are separate from accepting these Terms.

Wellbeing support and assessments

Cozy Health supports personal wellbeing, self-reflection, assessment tracking and selected provider connections. It is not an emergency service or a substitute for professional care. Assessments do not diagnose conditions or prescribe treatment. Read the Health and Assessment Disclosures.

Acceptable use

Do not harass, exploit or impersonate others; post unlawful or sexually exploitative content; circumvent access restrictions; scrape private data; or misuse provider credentials. Community participation is subject to the Community Guidelines and Child Safety Standards.

Your content and sharing

You retain ownership of your contributions and grant the permissions necessary to store, process and display them for the features you choose. Private journals do not become public community posts. Provider sharing depends on separate permissions and can be revoked for future access.

Our software, branding and licensed materials remain protected. Your permission to use them is limited to the service under these Terms; uploading third-party material requires appropriate permission. We do not acquire ownership of your private journals or permission to sell them or use them in advertising.

Subscriptions

Paid billing is not active for this launch. Selecting an unavailable plan does not charge you or grant paid access. Future paid offers must disclose the price, billing interval, eligibility, renewal and cancellation terms before purchase.

When activated, paid mobile purchases use Apple In-App Purchase or Google Play Billing. Store rules and mandatory consumer law govern applicable refunds and renewal management. Deleting the app or your account does not cancel a store subscription.

Student eligibility, expiry and renewal requirements must be explained before any Student purchase. We do not silently convert Student users to a higher-priced plan.

Safety, availability and account action

We may restrict or suspend misuse and investigate reports. Submit appeals to Team@cozyhealth.org. Availability and message delivery cannot be guaranteed. Nothing here excludes rights or liabilities that applicable law does not permit us to exclude.

Changes and contact

Nigerian law governs these Terms to the extent permitted by applicable law. Mandatory protections and rights to competent local courts in your habitual place of residence remain available. These Terms impose no mandatory arbitration or waiver of statutory complaint rights.

Contact Team@cozyhealth.org if you want help resolving a dispute; this does not prevent contacting a regulator or court. Material changes are versioned and communicated as required, with fresh acceptance where necessary. Notices may also be sent to the company address above.

Email Team@cozyhealth.org. Requests enter a shared team queue and are assigned to an available team member. Responses are generally faster between 8am and 5pm West Africa Time (WAT, UTC+1). These are not guaranteed operating hours or a response-time promise; the inbox is not continuously monitored.

Health Data Consent

Version 1.0

Your explicit choice

I consent to Cozy Health Limited (registration number 8215009), Igwe Street, Rumuodara, Rivers State, Nigeria, processing the health and wellbeing information I choose to provide, including moods, journals/recordings and assessment responses/results, to deliver the selected features explained at cozyhealth.org/privacy. I can read the Health and Assessment Disclosures at cozyhealth.org/health-disclosures. This is a separate explicit choice from accepting the Terms, optional analytics, diagnostics and marketing.

Sharing stays separate

This choice does not enable every provider-sharing category. I choose provider sharing independently and can change those choices in My Provider.

Changing your choice

Email Team@cozyhealth.org with the subject “Withdraw health-data consent”, or request account deletion using Settings → Delete Account or cozyhealth.org/support. We verify identity proportionately. Withdrawal stops future consent-based processing and may make related features unavailable. It does not undo earlier lawful processing or recall provider-held copies. Necessary retained information is restricted to its lawful purpose and retention period. Emergency resources remain accessible.

Young people

Users aged 13–17 need the applicable verified guardian authorization before health-data features are enabled. A guardian’s authorization is not automatic permission to read private journals, messages or provider records. The young person’s rights and choices remain relevant.

ugc_guidelines.title: Community Guidelines and Child Safety Standards
ugc_guidelines.content:
Community Guidelines and Child Safety Standards

Version 1.0

Respect and safety

Do not post harassment, hate, threats, explicit sexual content, grooming, child exploitation, scams, or encouragement of self-harm or violence. Do not publish another person’s private health or identifying information.

Reporting and blocking

Use the report and block controls available in the relevant feature, or contact Team@cozyhealth.org. Include enough context to locate a concern without sending unnecessary sensitive information. Do not assume every community control also exists in private provider messaging.

Review, action and appeals

Moderators may remove content, warn users, restrict features or suspend accounts depending on severity and context. Serious abuse can lead to immediate action; no fixed three-strike rule is promised. Where appropriate, affected users receive an explanation and can appeal to Team@cozyhealth.org by identifying the decision and relevant context. A different authorized team member should review an appeal where feasible.

Email Team@cozyhealth.org. Requests enter a shared team queue and are assigned to an available team member. Responses are generally faster between 8am and 5pm West Africa Time (WAT, UTC+1). These are not guaranteed operating hours or a response-time promise; the inbox is not continuously monitored.

Child safety

Child sexual abuse material, exploitation, grooming, sexual solicitation of minors and facilitation of child abuse are prohibited. Team@cozyhealth.org is the shared team contact for child-safety reports. Include the account/content location and non-graphic context; do not download, forward or redistribute illegal imagery.

We assess reports, restrict harmful content/access, preserve necessary evidence securely and make legally required reports to relevant authorities. The shared inbox is not continuously monitored or an emergency reporting service. Under-13 accounts are not permitted; additional age/guardian requirements apply to younger users.

Crisis concerns

The community is not continuously monitored for emergencies. If someone is in immediate danger, contact appropriate emergency services.

tos.title: Provider Terms of Use
tos.content:
Provider Terms of Use

Version 1.0

Professional use

These Terms govern individual providers using the dashboard supplied by Cozy Health Limited (registration number 8215009), Igwe Street, Rumuodara, Rivers State, Nigeria. Provide accurate identity, practice and professional-licence information, maintain authorization to practise where applicable and use your own account. Provider access is for adults authorized to perform the professional role. A verification indicator is not a clinical endorsement.

This launch serves consumer-controlled individual accounts and optional individual provider connections. It is not offered under these Terms as an organization-managed clinical record or outsourced patient-management service.

Authorized patient relationships

Access only patients with whom you have an authorized active connection, for the disclosed care-support purpose. Patient links do not enable every category: respect separate permissions, selected assessment-result grants and revocation. Do not bypass restrictions or access another provider’s patients.

Clinical responsibility and service boundaries

The dashboard supports selected wellbeing records, provider messages, notes, assigned resources and authorized reports. It is not an emergency service, diagnostic engine or replacement for clinical judgment. You remain responsible for professional duties and explaining your availability and response arrangements to patients.

Data you may access

Patient identity/link status and assignment progress may remain visible while connected. Optional sharing covers mood entries, journal summaries, assessment results and provider notes as authorized. Journal bodies, recordings and transcripts are excluded from journal-sharing endpoints. Titles and summaries can still be sensitive.

Security and downloaded copies

Protect credentials, devices and exported files. Do not share accounts, scrape data, repurpose it for advertising or redistribute it without authorization. Apply minimum necessary access and report suspected compromise to Team@cozyhealth.org.

Revocation stops subsequent authorized access; it cannot recall data you already viewed, copied or downloaded. You are responsible for lawful handling of those copies, retention obligations and secure disposal. Do not rely on this portal as your only legally required clinical record.

Patient rights and practice responsibilities

Maintain your practice’s own privacy notices and permissions. Coordinate rights requests with Team@cozyhealth.org. Where patients are minors, verify the authority and permissions applicable to the service you provide. Platform policy acceptance does not replace professional consent requirements.

Guardian authorization for platform eligibility does not automatically give access to private journals, messages or professional records. Respect the young person’s confidentiality and applicable rights.

Agreements, fees and termination

Cozy Health determines operation of its consumer platform; you determine your independent professional purposes and obligations for information you lawfully receive. Actual roles depend on the arrangement and law, not merely labels. Cooperate on rights requests, incidents and lawful restrictions.

Do not start organization-managed clinic processing or processing requiring a processor agreement, business associate agreement or other regulated arrangement until the requirements and infrastructure are approved in writing and necessary agreements are signed. These Terms are not such an agreement or certification of HIPAA, GDPR or NDPA compliance.

Consumer subscriptions do not establish provider fees. These Terms create no provider charge; any future fee requires separately disclosed acceptance. We may restrict unsafe/unauthorized access and investigate reports. On termination, stop using the portal and handle retained copies lawfully. Submit complaints or appeals to Team@cozyhealth.org.

Acceptance and changes

Acceptance is recorded against the displayed version and individual provider account. Material required changes need fresh review where necessary. Nigerian law governs to the extent permitted by applicable law, without removing mandatory protections or competent-court rights elsewhere. Nothing excludes liability or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Email Team@cozyhealth.org. Requests enter a shared team queue and are assigned to an available team member. Responses are generally faster between 8am and 5pm West Africa Time (WAT, UTC+1). These are not guaranteed operating hours or a response-time promise; the inbox is not continuously monitored.

privacy_policy.title: Provider Privacy Notice
privacy_policy.content:
Provider Privacy Notice

Version 1.0

Operator and audience

Cozy Health Limited (registration number 8215009), Igwe Street, Rumuodara, Rivers State, Nigeria, determines operation of its provider dashboard. This notice covers providers and patient information handled through optional individual connections. It supplements cozyhealth.org/privacy and does not replace your practice’s own patient notice.

Email Team@cozyhealth.org. Requests enter a shared team queue and are assigned to an available team member. Responses are generally faster between 8am and 5pm West Africa Time (WAT, UTC+1). These are not guaranteed operating hours or a response-time promise; the inbox is not continuously monitored.

Provider and practice information

We process your name, email, practice/professional details, licence and verification information where supplied, timezone, credentials, session information and support communications. Passwords are hashed rather than stored as readable passwords.

Patient workflows

We process patient links and sharing choices, assigned-resource status, provider notes, direct provider messages, authorized assessment results and generated reports. Access is scoped to the active relationship and relevant permissions. Journal-sharing endpoints exclude full journal text, recordings and transcripts.

Access records and purposes

Access records may include actor and resource identifiers, actions, timestamps, request IP and user-agent information. Infrastructure proxies can affect the recorded IP. These records support security, authorization, accountability and investigation; they are not a promise of continuous clinical monitoring.

Recipients and responsibilities

Patient information is made available to authorized linked providers and appropriately authorized staff, with vendors handling what is needed to run and secure the service. Providers remain responsible for their independent professional records, downloaded copies, onward disclosures and notices. Actual legal roles depend on the arrangement and law.

We rely on contract where applicable for the requested provider service, legitimate interests for proportionate security, fraud prevention and accountability, and legal obligations where required. Consent-based health processing/sharing requires separate permission. Accepting this notice is not health consent, treatment consent or a processor agreement.

Railway hosts the app/database and private files in the western United States; Brevo supports transactional email. Cloudflare supplies DNS rather than proxying application/API traffic. Formspree handles the public waitlist, not patient intake. Restricted international transfers require an applicable lawful mechanism and safeguards; ask Team@cozyhealth.org for details. We do not sell patient information or share it for cross-context behavioural advertising.

This launch does not offer organization-managed clinic processing. Assess actual roles and execute any required regulated-data agreements before expanding the model. This notice does not establish a missing agreement or claim universal regulatory compliance.

Analytics and diagnostics

PostHog is unconfigured for launch and patient-data dashboard screens are not instrumented with it. Optional consumer analytics excludes patient content, assessment results, crisis activity and provider messages. Any configured technical diagnostics must exclude patient content and credentials.

Patient controls and retention

Patients can change optional sharing or revoke a connection. Subsequent access respects the change; already downloaded copies cannot be recalled. Reconnection starts with optional categories off. Unlinking and account deletion are different actions.

Provider account information is kept while active and needed to operate the service. Closure/verified rights requests trigger applicable deletion or restriction. Routine security/access records have a two-year limit, and remaining account files/backups a 30-day deletion/expiry limit after account deletion, subject to documented legal obligations or holds. Patient information follows the consumer retention policy. Providers must apply their own lawful schedules to independent professional records and explain those to individuals.

Rights, requests and security

Contact Team@cozyhealth.org for access, correction, deletion or privacy complaints. We verify identity and authority proportionately and coordinate requests involving practice records. Applicable rights and exceptions depend on the role and relevant law. Report suspected misuse promptly and avoid including patient health content in an initial support email.

We respond within applicable legal deadlines and explain any lawful exception or permitted extension. You may complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission at ndpc.gov.ng or the competent authority where you live. Material changes are versioned and communicated as required.

review_issues: Obtain written Railway confirmation/appropriate agreement covering sensitive health data and record applicable international-transfer safeguards; verify Brevo, Formspree and support-mail vendor arrangements.
Complete and verify age/guardian enforcement for users aged 13–17, including social-sign-in and offline paths, before enabling health-data features for minors.
Verify and activate the approved retention limits across private files, backups, routine security logs and Formspree; document legal holds and deletion replay after restoration.
Complete country-by-country availability/representation/health-data review and children’s privacy impact assessment before worldwide health-data activation.
Assign operational safety escalation and appeal cover and verify permissions for every assessment/resource before enabling that content.
